title: Director, Global Sales, Central Region
description:
Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group is seeking a Director, Global Sales, Central Region US to join our Commercial - Global Sales team.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset?

This is a remote position based in Texas, operating as part of the Mandarin Oriental Corporate Office in New York and the wider Global Sales team.

The Director, Global Sales, Central Region US is responsible for managing and developing travel industry relationships across the designated Central US market. Acting as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, the role creates and executes strategic account plans, strengthens client relationships, drives revenue and market-share growth, and maximises transient and group business opportunities across the Mandarin Oriental portfolio through travel agency partners.

The position covers Texas and the wider Central US region and reports to the Director, Travel Industry, The Americas. Regular travel is required, and the successful candidate must be based in Texas and live within a one-hour drive of a major airport.

As Director, Global Sales, Central Region US, you will be responsible for the following duties:

•
Account Management: Manage and develop a portfolio of key travel industry accounts through planned sales activities aligned with the overall Global Sales strategy.

•
Strategic Account Planning: Create and implement account plans that maximise revenue from established and target accounts while supporting the diversification of Mandarin Oriental’s client base.

•
Revenue Generation: Achieve or exceed agreed revenue and room-night goals across all assigned accounts and geographical territories.

•
Business Development: Identify and convert transient and group business opportunities across Mandarin Oriental’s global portfolio.

•
Regional Sales Growth: Generate revenue from travel advisors, agencies and prospective business partners throughout the assigned Central US region.

•
Travel Industry Partnerships: Serve as the primary point of contact for travel agency partnerships in the region, managing client engagement and facilitating initiatives that generate opportunities for Mandarin Oriental hotels.

•
Client Relationships: Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with key travel advisors, agency partners and industry stakeholders.

•
Fan Club Development: Promote Mandarin Oriental’s Fan Club preferred agency partner programme through advisor enrolment, training and ongoing engagement initiatives.

•
Hotel Collaboration: Work closely with hotel-level sales colleagues to align account strategies, share client insights and support exceptional customer satisfaction.

•
Sales Events: Lead annual Global Sales Calendar activities across the region, including roadshows, sales trips, workshops and client events.

•
Industry Representation: Coordinate and participate in relevant trade shows, networking opportunities and industry events as required.

•
Client Experiences: Host in-person client meetings, hotel site inspections and familiarisation trips across the Mandarin Oriental portfolio.

•
Market Intelligence: Secure, analyse and evaluate economic, competitive and market information relevant to the assigned territories.

•
Performance Reporting: Produce and analyse reports relating to assigned accounts, markets, sales activity and business performance.

•
Salesforce Management: Develop and maintain an accurate and up-to-date database of accounts, contacts, opportunities and activities in Salesforce.

•
Internal Communication: Participate in weekly sales meetings, monthly segment updates, regular one-to-one meetings and other relevant internal discussions.

•
Cross-Functional Support: Provide assistance and support to wider Global Sales operations and hotel teams based on evolving business requirements.

•
Brand Representation: Represent Mandarin Oriental professionally and consistently during client meetings, sales events, familiarisation trips and industry engagements.

•
Policies & Standards: Comply with Mandarin Oriental’s standard policies, programmes and approved corporate travel requirements.

As Director, Global Sales, Central Region US, we expect from you

• Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Hotel Management, Business Administration, Marketing or a related discipline.

• At least four years of sales experience within luxury hotel sales and/or a global sales environment.

• Established travel industry and client relationships within Texas or the wider Central US region.

• Proven experience managing and developing a portfolio of key travel industry or agency accounts.

• A strong track record of meeting or exceeding ambitious revenue, room-night and business-growth goals.

• Experience creating and delivering strategic account plans that generate measurable commercial results.

• Strong understanding of the luxury travel industry, including transient and group business opportunities.

• Excellent client management, relationship-building, problem-solving and organisational skills.

• Ability to manage changing workloads, competing timelines and evolving priorities within a fast-paced environment.

• Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across different functions, seniority levels and external organisations.

• A diplomatic and tactful communication style when working with colleagues, clients, travel advisors and business partners.

• Experience managing approved budgets, allocating resources effectively and controlling expenses in accordance with corporate travel policies.

• Excellent written, verbal and presentation skills in English.

• Ability and willingness to travel regularly throughout the assigned territory and to other locations as required.

• You must be based in Texas and live within a one-hour drive of a major airport.

Our commitment to you:

•
Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.

•
MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.

•
Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.

•
Retirement Plans. When you show commitment to us, we reciprocate. We offer different retirement plans depending on the length of your service and your role.

Pay & Benefits

• $110,000 to $140,000 based on experience

• A competitive benefits package, including health, dental and vision

• Paid time off

• Company-paid Short Term Disability coverage(i.e.) Medical/Accident insurance

title: Development & Feasibility Senior Analyst, Americas
description:
Mandarin Oriental Hotel Group is seeking a Development & Feasibility Senior Analyst, Americas to join our Development - Americas team.

Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset?

This position is based within our Americas Corporate Office, with hybrid working arrangements considered, and forms part of the wider Development - Americas team.

The Development & Feasibility Senior Analyst, Americas is responsible for supporting the growth of Mandarin Oriental's hotel management and branded residences business throughout North America, Latin America, and the Caribbean. The role is focused on conducting financial underwriting, feasibility studies, market analysis, and investment evaluations for new hotel and branded residences opportunities, while preparing the analytical materials and business cases that support strategic development decisions from origination through completion.

The position covers North America, Latin America, and the Caribbean and reports to the Senior Manager, Development - Americas. This role requires collaboration with Development, Residential, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Technical Services teams, together with external owners, developers, investors, consultants, and brokers across the region.

As Development & Feasibility Senior Analyst, Americas, you will be responsible for:

Lead financial underwriting and feasibility analyses for new management contracts, conversions, acquisitions, branded residences developments, and ground-up projects.

Prepare detailed operating pro formas, discounted cash flow valuations, investment analyses, and financial return models, including IRR and NPV calculations.

Conduct market studies using STR, CoStar, and other industry data sources to evaluate market demand, competitive positioning, and financial performance opportunities.

Assess supply and demand dynamics, market penetration, ADR, RevPAR, GOPPAR, and competitive landscape considerations for prospective developments.

Recommend preliminary facilities programming, including guestrooms, food and beverage concepts, spa and wellness facilities, meeting and event spaces, and residences components.

Prepare investment committee memoranda, feasibility reports, RFP responses, presentations, Letters of Intent, and other deal documentation for senior leadership review.

Support negotiations through financial analysis, scenario modelling, and evaluation of commercial terms.

Coordinate due diligence activities and collaborate with internal stakeholders throughout the lifecycle of development opportunities.

Partner closely with Development, Residential, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Technical Services teams to support project evaluation and execution.

Monitor market trends, industry developments, competitive activity, and investment opportunities across the luxury hospitality and branded residences sectors.

Contribute to process improvement initiatives through automation, standardized financial models, and AI-enabled analytical tools.

Develop and maintain relationships with consultants, brokers, owners, developers, and industry contacts across the region.

Produce analysis and recommendations that support informed development and investment decisions.

Perform additional duties as required to support business objectives.

As Development & Feasibility Senior Analyst, Americas, we expect from you:

Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Finance, Business, Economics, Real Estate, or a related discipline.

A minimum of five years of experience in hotel feasibility, development underwriting, investment analysis, hospitality consulting, revenue strategy, asset management, or a related field.

Strong financial modelling capabilities, including DCF valuation, IRR, NPV, and investment analysis.

Experience preparing operating forecasts, feasibility studies, and investment recommendations for development opportunities.

Working knowledge of hotel financial performance metrics, including USALI, ADR, RevPAR, GOPPAR, and hotel management agreement economics.

Experience utilizing STR, CoStar, and other market intelligence and benchmarking tools.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex financial and market data.

Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and effectively.

Ability to prepare executive-level reports, presentations, and business cases for leadership review.

Experience with automation, financial modelling enhancements, or AI-enabled analytical tools would be advantageous.

Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build effective working relationships across multiple functions and cultures.

Demonstrated commercial judgement, attention to detail, and discretion when working with confidential information.

Luxury hospitality, branded residences, mixed-use developments, or hotel real estate experience would be considered advantageous.

Ability and willingness to travel throughout the Americas region as required.

Our commitment to you:

Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you continue to grow and develop.

MOstay. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can experience Mandarin Oriental hotels around the world through complimentary nights and attractive accommodation rates for you and your loved ones.

Health & Colleague Wellness. Your wellbeing matters to us, and we offer a variety of health and wellness programmes designed to support our colleagues globally.

Retirement Plans. We offer retirement programmes aligned to your role and length of service.

Competitive medical, dental, and vision coverage.

Paid time off.

Company-match 401(k).

Company-paid Short-Term Disability and accident insurance coverage.

About the job

Based at the Mandarin Oriental New York within the Housekeeping Department in New York the Substitute Room Attendant is responsible for the overall cleanliness of all guestrooms that they are assigned to clean. The Substitute Room Attendant reports to the Director of Housekeeping.

As Substitute Room Attendant, you will responsible for the following duties:

Guest Room Cleanliness and Tidiness:

• Ensure occupied and vacant guestrooms are cleaned and maintained up to the exact standard as demonstrated by Housekeeping supervisory staff during initial training.

• Remove all soiled linens and towels from room and store on back landings.

• Thoroughly clean guest bathrooms, bathroom walls, bathtub, shower staff, water closet using the suggested chemicals.  After cleaning, dry all areas, fixtures and surfaces.

• Arrange all toiletries straightened on a piece of cloth in occupied guestrooms.

• Replenish all amenities and terry items.

• Efficiently make bed to meet appearance standard as demonstrated.

• Arrange all clothing items in occupied guestrooms are folded neatly according to standard as demonstrated.

• Upkeep guestroom and bathroom to include all inside windows and mirrors.

• Remove all room service trays from guestroom hallways and/or corridor to be brought to back landings and call for pick up.

• Vacuum the guestroom’s carpet and wipe down furniture and baseboards according to standard in all assigned work areas.

• Double check cleanliness of completed work area and placement of amenities in each complete guestroom before moving on to the next task.

Guestroom equipment and facilities:

• Recognize and report all missing, damaged or sub-standard furniture, fixtures and equipment.

• Ensure that all electronic devices (television, remote controls, stereo, telephones) are working properly.

Guest Requests Handling:

• Evaluate work assignment and prioritize work load according to guest requests.

• Ensure all guestrooms assigned are completed with correct status marked at the end of the day including any information for input into guest history file.

Others:

• Organize supply closets and work areas so that the Housekeeping Department operates, maintains and consistently meets efficient standards.

• Return all articles left by guest to Lost & Found.

• Adhere to Do Not Disturb policy.

NOTE: The above is not an all-inclusive list of job duties and responsibilities. Mandarin Oriental, New York reserves the right to add, delete, change or modify the job duties and responsibilities described in this job description at its discretion with notice.

As Substitute Room Attendants, we expect from you:

• Reading, writing and oral proficiency in the English language, willing to work a flexible schedule and holidays.

• Be a self-motivator and motivator of others, must be able to work in a high pace and dynamic operation, be able to work together with other colleagues, have a pleasant, friendly and helpful manner.

• Maintain a clean and healthy personal hygiene and grooming, work in a safe, prudent and organized manner.

• Have the ability to handle multiple tasks at one time while maintaining the highest standards in room/hotel cleanliness.

• Have excellent communication and organization skills, be able to consistently delight and satisfy our guest, have the ability to handle guest requests in a detailed manner, have high attention to details
